intro.title: Hello, I'm Alexander
intro.content: A product designer and developer with over a decade of experience building digital products that matter. I believe in the power of thoughtful design and clean code to create experiences that stand the test of time.

whatIDo.title: What I Do
whatIDo.content: I specialize in product strategy, user experience design, and full-stack development. My work spans from early-stage startups to enterprise solutions, always with a focus on creating meaningful impact.

interests.title: Interests & Passions
interests.content: Beyond the digital realm, I'm fascinated by the intersection of craftsmanship and technology.

items.title: Horology
items.description: The art of watchmaking teaches us about precision, patience, and the beauty of mechanical complexity.

items.title: Architecture
items.description: Great buildings, like great software, balance form and function in ways that inspire and endure.

items.title: Photography
items.description: Capturing moments helps me see design in everyday life and appreciate visual storytelling.

items.title: Writing
items.description: Articulating ideas clearly is a skill that serves both design documentation and personal reflection.

philosophy.title: Design Philosophy
philosophy.content: I believe that truly great design is invisible. It doesn't call attention to itself but instead enables people to accomplish their goals effortlessly. Like a well-crafted timepiece, the best products feel inevitable—as if they could have been designed no other way.

principles.title: Simplicity Over Complexity
principles.description: Remove everything that doesn't serve the core purpose.

principles.title: Timelessness Over Trends
principles.description: Build for the long term, not the fleeting moment.

principles.title: Craft Over Speed
principles.description: Take the time to do things properly.

principles.title: Impact Over Output
principles.description: Measure success by outcomes, not deliverables.
